declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement in support of preliminary approval. Hargrove Lane LLP proposed a $36 million class fund, $7 million in separately paid fees and expenses, automatic distribution, and payment of any unawarded fees to the class. Brightline countered with a $30 million class fund and $5 million in fees and expenses, accepting automatic distribution and payment of any unawarded fees to the class. The parties then exchanged class-fund proposals of $33 million, $31 million, and $32 million, with the proposed fee remaining $5 million. Brightline offered a $31.5 million class fund, which we accepted. The final agreement provides automatic payments to identified class members, $5 million in separately paid fees and expenses subject to court approval, no clear-sailing commitment, and payment of any unawarded fees to the class. Fees were discussed from the first round, not deferred until class relief was settled. We assessed the $31.5 million fund in light of the roughly $64 million in disputed charges, the risks of class certification and trial, and the approximately two-to-three-year wait for trial. Our confidential assessment was a roughly 55% chance of prevailing at trial with an approximately $50 million award if successful, before accounting for certification risk. The negotiated fund provides substantial relief without that delay or risk; the court retains authority to review the fee request.
